items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: The name 'William' appears only in the interviewer's turn ('Why was William?') with no response or further mention by the interviewee establishing a personal connection.

ctx.x: She's no dice. We've got a dice game on.
I never thought we could pick them up then. Why was William? Well we were talking about those records and that, you made of the Spikes Brothers and Dink
and all. Dink died, you know, a couple years ago.
